entries.title: Broken object level authorization
entries.description: A caller can act on an object without an authorization decision for that object.
evidenceRequirements: Identify caller-controlled object identifiers.
Show the object-level authorization decision or an exploit path.
entries.severityFrame: High when another tenant or repository can be read or changed; critical for broad privileged compromise.

entries.title: Broken authentication
entries.description: Authentication, credential, token, or session handling permits identity compromise.
evidenceRequirements: Show the authentication requirement and credential/session validation path.
Cover bypass, replay, expiry, and failure handling where applicable.
entries.severityFrame: High for account takeover; critical when privileged identities or all tenants are exposed.

entries.title: Broken object property level authorization
entries.description: Request or response properties are writable or readable beyond the caller's authority.
evidenceRequirements: List bound request and emitted response properties.
Show allowlisting or per-property authorization for sensitive fields.
entries.severityFrame: High for sensitive disclosure or privilege-bearing property mutation.

entries.title: Unrestricted resource consumption
entries.description: Unbounded request rate, size, concurrency, fan-out, or downstream work enables denial of service or spend abuse.
evidenceRequirements: Show rate, size, concurrency, timeout, and fan-out bounds relevant to the boundary.
Identify the partition key for caller-specific limits.
entries.severityFrame: High when an unauthenticated or low-privilege caller can exhaust shared resources or trigger material spend.

entries.title: Broken function level authorization
entries.description: A caller can reach an operation outside its assigned role or repository scope.
evidenceRequirements: Show route/function authorization and role or repository scoping.
Exercise an identity lacking the required privilege.
entries.severityFrame: High for cross-role operations; critical for administrative compromise.

entries.title: Unrestricted access to sensitive business flows
entries.description: Automation can abuse a sensitive workflow even when each request is otherwise authorized.
evidenceRequirements: Identify business-sensitive side effects.
Show anti-automation, quotas, idempotency, and anomaly controls where applicable.
entries.severityFrame: Medium by default; high when abuse creates irreversible state, spend, or third-party impact.

entries.title: Server-side request forgery
entries.description: Caller influence over a server-side network target reaches unintended hosts or protocols.
evidenceRequirements: Trace caller influence to network destinations.
Show scheme, host, address-range, redirect, and DNS-rebinding controls.
entries.severityFrame: High for internal network access or credential theft; critical for infrastructure compromise.

entries.title: Security misconfiguration
entries.description: Transport, CORS, error, header, parser, or platform configuration exposes the boundary.
evidenceRequirements: Show the effective transport, origin, error, header, and parser configuration.
Use deterministic configuration findings where available.
entries.severityFrame: Medium by default; high when the configuration enables credentialed cross-origin access or sensitive disclosure.

entries.title: Improper inventory management
entries.description: An obsolete, undocumented, or unintended boundary remains externally reachable.
evidenceRequirements: Link the boundary to its owner, consumers, deployment exposure, and intended lifecycle.
Identify obsolete versions or shadow endpoints.
entries.severityFrame: Medium for unmanaged exposure; high when an obsolete boundary lacks current controls.

entries.title: Unsafe consumption of APIs
entries.description: Data or behavior from another service is trusted without validation, bounds, or safe failure handling.
evidenceRequirements: Show validation of remote data and response bounds.
Show timeout, redirect, error, and compromised-provider handling.
entries.severityFrame: Medium by default; high when remote data reaches privileged sinks.

entries.title: Injection into interpreters and system sinks
entries.description: Caller-controlled data changes the meaning of a query, command, path, template, or other interpreter input.
evidenceRequirements: Trace each untrusted value to system sinks.
Show parameterization, confinement, encoding, or strict allowlisting at the sink.
entries.severityFrame: High for data or filesystem compromise; critical for arbitrary command execution.

entries.title: Broken access control
entries.description: Reachability, origin, path, or action controls allow a caller outside the intended trust boundary.
evidenceRequirements: State the intended caller and trust boundary.
Show enforcement for direct requests, alternate methods, origins, and path variants.
entries.severityFrame: High for unauthorized data or action access; critical for systemic privilege escalation.

entries.title: Cross-site request forgery and session confusion
entries.description: Browser ambient authority can be replayed cross-site or attached to the wrong session or client.
evidenceRequirements: Establish whether browser ambient credentials are accepted.
Show origin, SameSite, anti-CSRF, session rotation, and client-binding controls as applicable.
entries.severityFrame: High for state-changing actions under another user's session.

entries.title: Credential stuffing and authentication brute force
entries.description: Authentication or recovery endpoints permit high-rate credential guessing or account enumeration.
evidenceRequirements: Identify authentication and recovery behavior.
Show identity- and source-partitioned throttling, enumeration resistance, and monitoring.
entries.severityFrame: High when reusable credentials or privileged accounts can be compromised.

entries.title: Missing boundary authorization control
entries.description: The boundary inventory cannot derive an authorization requirement for a callable inbound operation.
evidenceRequirements: Show the effective authentication and authorization facts derived for this boundary.
entries.severityFrame: High for callable operations; critical when an unauthenticated caller can trigger privileged side effects.

entries.title: Permissive cross-origin policy
entries.description: A browser origin policy allows any origin rather than a bounded allowlist.
evidenceRequirements: Show the effective origin policy and its derived source.
entries.severityFrame: High when arbitrary origins can make credentialed or sensitive API requests.

entries.title: Missing request rate or size limit
entries.description: The boundary inventory derives an absent rate or request-size limit.
evidenceRequirements: Show the effective rate and size limit facts derived for this boundary.
entries.severityFrame: Medium by default; high for expensive, unauthenticated, or shared-resource operations.
